security_findings.finding: Functional evaluator runs generated code in host globals using exec through a thread. Timeout cannot isolate or terminate arbitrary host effects.
security_findings.action: Keep inactive; replace execution adapter with existing gVisor judge before any future integration.

security_findings.finding: Generated code uses normal multiprocessing exec or Python host subprocesses; no application sandbox boundary, no credential/network separation. Parent process termination is not descendant cleanup.
security_findings.action: Preserve only; use isolated runner, bounded output/resource controls and cleanup on future adoption.

security_findings.finding: Selected external ranker/model loaded with trust_remote_code=True without a pinned revision. Effect depends on model/library; no model was loaded.
security_findings.action: Review selected artifact/code, pin identity and integrity, avoid permissive remote code when possible.

security_findings.finding: Raw HTTP requests have no explicit timeout. Source/tests/prompts are sent to configured local execution/model destinations. Request/result schemas and permissions differ from current API.
security_findings.action: Use trusted destination configuration, explicit deadlines, bounded payloads, privacy policy and isolated execution contracts.

security_findings.finding: shell=True command construction and developer-specific host Docker bind mounts; container isolation is not the current reviewed judge.
